ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a 3-row by 4-column array, with a total of twelve pentomino outlines composed of 5 unit squares. According to the reading order from left to right and from top to bottom, label them A to L. A is a straight bar of 5 horizontally consecutive squares; B is a shape with 4 squares at the bottom and 1 extra square above the far right end; C is a shape with 4 squares at the bottom and 1 extra square above near the middle; D is a block-like shape similar to 2 uneven rows; E is a rotated T-shape, with 3 vertical squares on the right side and 2 squares extending left from the middle; F is an X-shaped cross; G is a turning step-like shape; H is a U-shape, with 3 squares above and the left and right sides extending downward; I is a V-shaped turning shape, with two straight arms of length 3 meeting at one corner; J is an irregular F-shape; K is a skewed step-like/bent shape; L is a W-shaped staircase. Reasoning: Try folding one by one along vertical, horizontal, or diagonal lines. A's straight bar of 5 squares has a line of symmetry; after B is reflected, the extra square at the end cannot match, so it has no line of symmetry; C's single square above is not in a position that can make the 4 squares at the bottom match in pairs, so it has no line of symmetry; D cannot completely coincide under up-down, left-right, or diagonal reflection, so it has no line of symmetry; this T-shape E can coincide when reflected along the middle horizontal line, so it has a line of symmetry; this X-shape F can coincide along vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines, so it has lines of symmetry; after G is reflected, the staircase positions do not match, so it has no line of symmetry; this U-shape H can coincide when reflected along the middle vertical line, so it has a line of symmetry; this V-shape I can coincide when reflected along the diagonal line that bisects the angle, so it has a line of symmetry; J is an irregular F-shape, and reflection cannot make it coincide, so it has no line of symmetry; K is skewed, and reflection cannot make it coincide, so it has no line of symmetry; this W-shaped staircase L can coincide when reflected along a diagonal line, so it has a line of symmetry. Therefore those with lines of symmetry are A, E, F, H, I, L, that is, the straight bar, T-shape, X-shape, U-shape, V-shape, and W-shape, for a total of 6.

raw_record.question_text: How many of the twelve pentominoes pictured below have at least one line of symmetry?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a 3-by-4 array of twelve five-square pentomino outlines, then label them in reading order from top-left to bottom-right. For each labeled shape, visually try to fold or reflect it across plausible symmetry lines through the shape: vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines through cell centers or grid corners. Mark a shape symmetric if every square would land exactly on another square of the same pentomino under at least one such reflection. In the pictured set, the symmetric ones are the straight 5-in-a-row piece, the T-shaped piece, the X/cross-shaped piece, the U-shaped piece, the V-shaped corner piece, and the W/stair-step piece. Count these marked pieces to get 6.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个3行4列的阵列，共有十二个由5个单位正方形组成的五连方轮廓。按从左到右、从上到下的阅读顺序，把它们标为A到L。A是横向连续5格的直条；B是底部4格、最右端上方多1格的形状；C是底部4格、靠中间上方多1格的形状；D是类似2行不齐的块状形；E是一个旋转的T形，右侧竖3格，中间向左伸2格；F是X形十字；G是折转的阶状形；H是U形，上方3格且左右两边向下；I是V形转向形，两条长度为3的直臂在一个角相接；J是不规则F形；K是偏斜的阶状/折形；L是W形阶梯。推理：逐个尝试沿竖直、水平或对角线折叠。A的5格直条有对称线；B反射后端部多出的方格不能匹配，没有对称线；C上方单格不在能使底部4格成对匹配的位置，没有对称线；D上下左右或对角反射都不能完全重合，没有对称线；E这个T形沿中间横线反射可以重合，有对称线；F这个X形沿竖直、水平和对角线都可重合，有对称线；G反射后阶梯位置不匹配，没有对称线；H这个U形沿中间竖线反射可重合，有对称线；I这个V形沿角平分的对角线反射可重合，有对称线；J是不规则F形，反射不能重合，没有对称线；K偏斜，反射不能重合，没有对称线；L这个W形阶梯沿一条对角线反射可重合，有对称线。因此有对称线的是A、E、F、H、I、L，也就是直条、T形、X形、U形、V形和W形，共6个。
